'''Eijul''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], serving under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]] aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']]. Drommel did not think highly of his skills and intended to replace him when the ''Guardian'' returned to Imperial space.
